PlayerAnims:
The animation list of the armed hero: 44 pointers.

When: the animator reads it for every step of the player actor with $24 = $0B (the normal case in the field).
Sees: the hero stands, walks, sidesteps, thrusts and swings, and dies.
Why: see PlayerUnarmedAnims.
In: n/a (data): 44 words, index = animation id $1E ($00-$2B); each points to a list of 8-byte steps (duration, dx, dy, &frame) ending with $FFFF.
Out: the step and its frame leaf. Walk steps carry dx or dy of 2 pixels per frame (static reading, OQ-I014-1).
Clobbers: n/a (data).
PlayerUnarmedAnims:
The animation list of the unarmed hero: 26 pointers.

When: the animator reads it for every step of the player actor with $24 = $0A.
Sees: the hero walks and stands without his sword in towns and before he has a weapon.
Why: the animations of an actor are data, not code, so one animator drives every actor.
In: n/a (data): 26 words, index = animation id $1E; each points to a list of 8-byte steps (duration, dx, dy, &frame) ending with $FFFF.
Out: the step and its frame leaf (12-byte header, then the sprite map).
Clobbers: n/a (data).
